theorem: Retrieval after a causal break certifies operational memory. Preservation of reference entanglement across the break certifies coherent quantum memory and separates it from a classical trit memory.
process_tensor_boundary: Reference-entanglement preservation is a sufficient witness of coherent quantum memory, but its loss is not a necessary-and-sufficient test for classical multitime memory. Entanglement-breaking channels can still support genuinely nonclassical temporal correlations. A full classification requires explicit process-tensor instrument slots and causal constraints.
